{{Color box|{{party color|United Negros Alliance}}|border=darkgray}} [[United Negros Alliance|UNEGA]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Negros Occidental's 4th congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Negros Occidental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} The district consists of the area in north-central Negros Occidental immediately to the south of the capital city of [[Bacolod]]. It contains the cities of [[Bago, Negros Occidental|Bago]] and [[La Carlota, Negros Occidental|La Carlota]], and the municipalities of [[Pontevedra, Negros Occidental|Pontevedra]], [[Pulupandan]], [[San Enrique, Negros Occidental|San Enrique]] and [[Valladolid, Negros Occidental|Valladolid]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Jeffrey Ferrer|Jeffrey P. Ferrer]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP) and [[United Negros Alliance]] (UNEGA).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
